# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Please check the project for the supported versions. Generally, we provide security updates for the latest major release.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please do not report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues.

Instead, please report them to the project maintainers privately. You can report security vulnerabilities via the [GitHub Security Advisory](https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/security-advisories/guidance-on-reporting-and-writing/privately-reporting-a-security-vulnerability) feature if enabled on this repository, or by reaching out to the maintainers directly.

We will try to respond quickly, verify the vulnerability, and patch it in a timely manner.
